# EXPERIMENTAL: re-measured CPU cost rows, n=4096 only. NOT installed.
#
# The shipped cost.txt misranks bands: selection picks the slower one at 3
# of 8 operating points on the default reference, up to 1.84x, and
# tools/score_selection.py independently scores its pick at 52% of the best
# available. No pricing rule rescues the shipped rows -- every rule
# score_cost_rule.py implements tops out at 3 of 6 correct, and the one
# that ships is already among the best. The rows are what is wrong.
#
# These are the same cells re-measured with tools/hmf_tune.py --retune-cost,
# which could not run at all until d40f8a0 (it died on band 64's missing
# threshold after 160 rows -- a fair explanation for how the table drifted
# this far unnoticed).
#
# WHAT THEY CHANGE, measured against the clock at n=4096:
#
#   reference   snr   old pick -> new    t(old)   t(new)   effect
#   inspiral    6.0     256  ->  512      408us    207us   1.97x FASTER
#   shallow     5.5     512  -> 1024      981us    587us   1.67x FASTER
#   steep       5.5     256  ->  512      294us    208us   1.41x FASTER
#   steep       6.0     256  ->  512      136us    205us   1.50x slower
#
#   total over the four changed points: 1819us -> 1207us = 1.51x net
#
# Correct at 4 of 6 sampled points against the shipped table's 2 of 6. The
# n=4096 rows are COMPLETE -- 48 keys, 9560 rows, unchanged between two
# snapshots of the run -- so this is not a partial result.
#
# WHY NOT INSTALLED. One point regresses, which rules out "the rows were
# merely stale" -- fresher rows cannot make a correct ranking wrong -- and
# the run was stopped before covering every size the shipped table does
# (it reached n=1024, 2048, 4096, 16384 and part of 32768). Dropping these
# in wholesale would replace rows for sizes that were never re-measured.
# Installing wants a completed run and a human on the 1.50x regression.
#
# Measured on Ryzen AI Max+ 395, AVX3, with the gate as it ships.
#
# n band U K snr f beff margin relative_cost
